title: Copper Comet
message:
Copper Comet: an original chase loop in the manner of Rob Hubbard's Goldrunner (Amiga).
D minor, speed 3, A / B / A'. Single-cycle waves only: octave flicker, vibrato from the first
tick, hard decays, octave rips, a harmony a third below in B. No samples, no drums.
Source: songs/amiga_copper_comet.gen.js. Rendered and measured, not listened to.
